Overview

Kristiansand is a city in Agder with a population of 92,000. The capital of the south, a popular summer destination with sandy beaches, a zoo, and a lively waterfront. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
